name: GIWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created at this run's own 'Title Tyranny' relaunch battle royal, alongside a companion National Championship; not to be confused with the same-named title on either held GIWF wing.

name: GIWF National Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created alongside the World Heavyweight Championship at this run's own 'Title Tyranny' relaunch battle royal, awarded to the battle royal's own last-eliminated entrant.
